**Net revenue (EUR)** — gross revenue minus refunds, **excluding VAT** (divided by 1.20); shipping fees are kept in.
Formula: `(gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20`. Example: 120 € paid, no refund → 100 €.
